decision.notes: a fraud caught saves the ride's fare; a review costs 25,000 (a tenth of a typical fare); the team reviews at most 0.5% of the rides

gate.chosen: the decision is chosen on every seed (an operating point with a share, no refusal)
gate.capacity: the holdout's acted share never exceeds the capacity share (with one row's rounding)
gate.coverage: the holdout's realised value per ride lies inside the choice's 90% prediction interval on at least 6 of 8 seeds

objective: Does the decision core keep its word through the engine on the delivery-fraud replica? A stated review decision, chosen on out-of-fold scores, against what it realises on the holdout read once, over eight seeds.
